early_brake.headline: %(corner_name)s · Braked too soon
early_brake.what: You hit the brakes before your usual marker at %(corner_name)s.
early_brake.why: Early braking bleeds entry speed and costs lap time.

overspeed.headline: %(corner_name)s · %(speed_delta_kmh)s km/h too fast
overspeed.what: You arrived %(speed_delta_kmh)s km/h faster than your reference at %(corner_name)s.
overspeed.why: Overspeed forces panic steering or a mid-corner lift.
overspeed.action: %(brake_cue)s Brake harder or earlier — aim for %(ref_speed_kmh)s km/h.

early_throttle.headline: %(corner_name)s · Throttle too early
early_throttle.what: Power on before the apex at %(corner_name)s with high lateral load.
early_throttle.why: Early power unloads the front and can cause understeer or snap oversteer.

setup_tweak.headline: Setup · %(section_name)s %(delta_sign)s%(delta_abs)s
setup_tweak.why: Persistent balance issue with clean inputs.
setup_tweak.voice: Setup change ready. %(section_name)s %(delta_sign)s%(delta_abs)s. Load Auto Tweak in the pits.

setup_queued.headline: Queued · %(section_name)s %(delta_sign)s%(delta_abs)s
setup_queued.why: Balance cost with marginal inputs — will experiment in pits.

pit_auto_apply.headline: Pit · Auto_Tweak updated
pit_auto_apply.why: Prepared tweaks from this stint are now in Auto_Tweak.ini.
pit_auto_apply.action: Load Auto_Tweak.ini in the setup screen now.
pit_auto_apply.expected: Evaluate over the next flying laps.
pit_auto_apply.voice: Auto Tweak updated in the pits. Load it in setup.

setup_revert.headline: Setup · Reverted %(section_name)s
setup_revert.what: Last tweak to %(section_name)s hurt lap time.
setup_revert.voice: Reverted %(section_name)s change. Reload Auto Tweak in the pits.

learning.headline: Baseline ready · %(lap)s clean laps
learning.what: Enough representative laps logged — full coaching and setup evaluation on.
learning.why: Clean laps are cumulative; messy laps no longer wipe your progress.
learning.action: Keep driving — corner and tyre coaching stay active.
learning.voice: Baseline ready. Coaching and setup evaluation are live.

bootstrap_setup.headline: Bootstrap · %(track)s
bootstrap_setup.why: Clean laps not achievable with current setup — applying track baseline.
bootstrap_setup.voice: Track bootstrap. %(section_name)s %(delta_sign)s%(delta_abs)s. Load Auto Tweak in the pits.

loss_of_control.headline: %(corner_name)s · Loss of control
loss_of_control.why: Car balance exceeded safe slip envelope.
loss_of_control.action: Ease inputs; stabilization tweak queued for pits.
loss_of_control.expected: More predictable rotation on next stint.
loss_of_control.voice: Loss of control at %(corner_name)s. Ease the inputs.

intentional_rotation.headline: %(corner)s · Intentional rotation
intentional_rotation.what: Controlled yaw detected — no setup change needed.
intentional_rotation.why: Counter-steer and yaw rate match aggressive style.

grip_left.headline: %(corner_name)s · %(grip_left_pct)s%% grip unused
grip_left.what: At %(speed_kmh)s km/h you used %(grip_usage_pct)s%% of your own peak lateral G here.
grip_left.expected: Free time without setup changes — your data shows the grip exists.

lap_digest.headline: Lap %(lap_time)s · %(potential_gap_s)s s in your data
lap_digest.voice: Lap complete. %(potential_gap_s)s seconds in your own best sectors.

potential_gain.headline: Your pace · %(worst_corner)s +%(worst_delta_s)s s
potential_gain.what: Compared only to your own reference laps — no alien data.
potential_gain.expected: Potential lap %(potential_lap)s — %(potential_gap_s)s s gap from your sectors.

session_plan.headline: Session plan · %(potential_gap_s)s s on the table
session_plan.why: Ranked from your own stitched sectors — max two fixes.

narrow_approach.headline: %(corner_name)s · Approach too tight
narrow_approach.what: Steering corrections on entry and apex speed %(min_speed_kmh)s km/h below your reference (%(ref_min_speed_kmh)s km/h).
narrow_approach.why: A narrow line forces extra steering and kills mid-corner speed — technique fixes won't stick until the line widens.
narrow_approach.expected: Wider approach → less mid-corner correction → free entry speed.

line_wide_needed.headline: %(corner_name)s · Widen the approach
line_wide_needed.what: Entry steering and apex speed %(min_speed_kmh)s km/h vs your %(ref_min_speed_kmh)s km/h — this corner rewards a wider arc.
line_wide_needed.why: High-downforce cars need track width here to carry minimum speed; a tight line costs more than the geometric shortcut suggests.
line_wide_needed.expected: One steering input through the apex — %(input_steer)s

line_too_wide.headline: %(corner_name)s · Too wide for the grip patch
line_too_wide.what: You opened the line beyond your reference — apex speed %(min_speed_kmh)s km/h vs %(ref_min_speed_kmh)s km/h.
line_too_wide.why: %(grip_note)s Geometric width is not always fastest here; rubber and bumps reward a tighter arc.
line_too_wide.expected: Stay on the racing groove — less correction, more traction.

line_compromise.headline: %(corner_name)s · Sacrifice for %(payoff_corner)s
line_compromise.what: Mid-corner speed is down but this corner is a setup move — %(compromise_note)s
line_compromise.why: Compound sections win on chain exit speed, not each apex in isolation.
line_compromise.expected: Time lost here should come back at %(payoff_corner)s.

line_late_apex.headline: %(corner_name)s · Apex too late
line_late_apex.what: Min speed %(min_speed_kmh)s km/h vs your %(ref_min_speed_kmh)s km/h — throttle opens late on exit.
line_late_apex.why: Late apex bleeds exit speed; often caused by turning in too soon or a tight approach.

line_early_apex.headline: %(corner_name)s · Early apex for the chain
line_early_apex.what: Entry corrections and low min speed — this payoff corner may need an earlier apex than geometric ideal.
line_early_apex.why: Opening the exit toward %(next_corner)s matters more than a perfect single-corner line.
line_early_apex.expected: Prioritize exit speed over mid-corner perfection.

input_trail_brake.headline: %(corner_name)s · Trail brake into turn-in
input_trail_brake.what: Light brake release on entry with steering corrections — the car is not rotating cleanly.
input_trail_brake.why: Your inputs are separate when they should overlap briefly: brake and steer together, then bleed pressure.
input_trail_brake.expected: Front loads under trail brake → one clean turn-in.

chain_digest.headline: Chain · %(chain_id)s +%(total_delta_s)s s
chain_digest.why: Worst link: %(worst_corner)s (+%(worst_delta_s)s s) — treat the sequence as one corner.
chain_digest.expected: Sacrifice early corners if the chain exit gains time.
chain_digest.voice: Focus on the %(chain_id)s complex as one section.

line_fight.headline: %(corner_name)s · Fighting the line
line_fight.what: %(corrections)s steering corrections mid-corner — the car is not on your reference arc.
line_fight.why: Position errors mid-corner waste grip on corrections instead of acceleration.
line_fight.expected: One clean steering input through the apex.

late_apex.headline: %(corner_name)s · Apex too late
late_apex.what: Min speed %(min_speed_kmh)s km/h vs your %(ref_min_speed_kmh)s km/h — throttle opens late on exit.
late_apex.why: Late apex bleeds exit speed; often caused by turning in too soon or a tight approach.
late_apex.action: %(apex_cue)s — turn in slightly later next lap.

micro_gain.headline: %(corner_name)s · %(phase)s · ~%(gain_s)s s available
micro_gain.why: There is always time left — seconds early in a stint, hundredths once you are close.
micro_gain.action: Maximize grip, control, and speed through this phase — your own data proves it exists.
micro_gain.expected: Chase the next %(gain_s)s s — then find the one after.

setup_tradeoff.headline: Setup · %(section_name)s at limit
setup_tradeoff.why: Primary lever hit min/max — rebalancing via alternate levers.
setup_tradeoff.expected: Same balance goal via a different path.
setup_tradeoff.voice: Setup tradeoff ready. Load Auto Tweak in the pits.

kerb_grip_loss.headline: %(corner_name)s · Grip lost on kerb
kerb_grip_loss.what: Telemetry: load dropped %(max_load_drop_pct)s%% with slip spike during kerb contact.
kerb_grip_loss.why: Kerb impacts unload the tyre — vertical load and grip collapse until the car settles (F1 load-cell / ride-quality monitoring).
kerb_grip_loss.expected: Clip kerbs; don't steer hard while the tyre is unloaded.

painted_kerb_slip.headline: %(corner_name)s · Low-grip kerb edge
painted_kerb_slip.what: Light kerb contact with high slip — painted or marbled edge has less grip than tarmac rubber.
painted_kerb_slip.why: Partial suspension travel + slip spike = tyre on a low-μ surface, not full kerb support.
painted_kerb_slip.action: %(input_steer)s Stay on tarmac rubber where your reference lap had grip.
painted_kerb_slip.expected: Less correction after the kerb — grip returns on asphalt.

kerb_overload.headline: %(corner_name)s · Kerb too aggressive
kerb_overload.what: Suspension hit travel limit (%(max_susp_pct)s) multiple times this corner.
kerb_overload.why: At full travel the chassis hops and tyres leave the surface — mechanical grip gone until reload.
kerb_overload.expected: Smoother kerb clip — tyre stays in contact with track.

platform_hop.headline: %(corner_name)s · Platform hop after kerb
platform_hop.what: Vertical spike + yaw correction after kerb — the platform was unsettled.
platform_hop.why: High-frequency impacts transfer through the tyre spring; yaw correction while unloaded costs time.
platform_hop.expected: Let the car settle before adding steering or throttle.

bump_unsettled.headline: %(corner_name)s · Bump unsettled grip
bump_unsettled.what: Vertical G spike (max %(max_vert_g)sG) without clean kerb support — bump disturbed the platform.
bump_unsettled.why: Accelerometers on race cars separate bump inputs from aero platform control; inputs mid-bump overload the tyre.
bump_unsettled.expected: Straighten inputs over the bump; throttle after the car reloads.

shift_unsettling_downshift.headline: %(corner_name)s · Downshift unsettled the car
shift_unsettling_downshift.what: %(gear_change)s at %(phase)s with %(lat_g)s G lateral and %(steer_deg)s° steer.
shift_unsettling_downshift.why: Downshifts send engine-braking torque to the rear axle. Under lateral load the platform yawed — F1 boxes blip the throttle in the braking zone when the wheel is straight for this reason.
shift_unsettling_downshift.action: Complete downshifts earlier in the brake zone — straight steering, then turn-in.
shift_unsettling_downshift.voice: %(corner_name)s. Downshift earlier in the braking zone.

shift_unsettling_upshift.headline: %(corner_name)s · Upshift while still loaded
shift_unsettling_upshift.what: %(gear_change)s at %(phase)s with %(lat_g)s G lateral still on the car.
shift_unsettling_upshift.why: Even seamless upshifts move load briefly. Upshifting while the car is still cornering interrupts torque when the tyres need consistency.
shift_unsettling_upshift.action: Hold the gear until steering is unwound or the straight begins.
shift_unsettling_upshift.expected: Cleaner exit without a mid-corner torque step.
shift_unsettling_upshift.voice: %(corner_name)s. Upshift when the car is straight.

shift_late_downshift.headline: %(corner_name)s · Downshift after turn-in
shift_late_downshift.why: Late downshifts apply rear braking torque after the front has committed — the classic mid-corner lurch teams avoid with straight-line heel-toe sequencing.
shift_late_downshift.action: Finish all downshifts before turn-in — brake, blip, downshift, then rotate.
shift_late_downshift.expected: Entry rotation without a rear kick.

shift_early_upshift.headline: %(corner_name)s · Upshift before exit is unwound
shift_early_upshift.why: Short-shifting can help control, but upshifting under power while still loaded costs rear grip on traction-limited exits.
shift_early_upshift.action: Stay in gear until the wheel is straight enough to accept full throttle.

shift_harsh_downshift.headline: %(corner_name)s · Harsh downshift — rear stepped
shift_harsh_downshift.what: %(gear_change)s at %(speed_kmh)s km/h triggered a rear platform spike.
shift_harsh_downshift.why: Aggressive downshifts spike rear slip/yaw — the same dynamic F1 drivers manage when dropping to first gear under braking.
shift_harsh_downshift.action: Slower shift sequence or one gear fewer — match revs before releasing the clutch.
shift_harsh_downshift.expected: Rear stays planted through the downshift.

shift_harsh_upshift.headline: %(corner_name)s · Upshift disturbed balance
shift_harsh_upshift.why: Torque interruption during load transfer can unload the rear briefly — even on seamless boxes.
shift_harsh_upshift.action: Upshift on straighter sections or short-shift intentionally for control.
shift_harsh_upshift.expected: No yaw step after the paddle pull.

shift_settling_downshift.headline: Downshift · %(gear_change)s settled
shift_settling_downshift.what: Good downshift in the braking zone at %(corner_name)s.
shift_settling_downshift.why: Straight-line downshifts with matched revs settle the rear before turn-in — proper heel-toe sequencing.
shift_settling_downshift.action: Repeat this timing — brake zone, blip, rotate.

shift_settling_upshift.headline: Upshift · %(gear_change)s clean
shift_settling_upshift.what: Upshift on a straight section at %(speed_kmh)s km/h.
shift_settling_upshift.why: Shifting with low lateral load keeps the platform calm — standard straight-line upshift timing.
shift_settling_upshift.action: Keep this pattern on long straights.
